item.title: Community Champion of the Week: Volunteers of America of Pennsylvania
item.description: Volunteers of America of Pennsylvania (VOAPA) is a community-based organization whose ministry of service is to empower vulnerable communities, families, and individuals through support and resources that lead to health and stability. Since 1896, VOAPA has provided highly effective services centered around housing, health, and children, youth and families. VOAPA has regional offices located in the Northeast, Lehigh Valley, Central, and Southwest Pennsylvania communities.
